review.mkdir(exist_ok=False)

head=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=root,text=True).strip(); assert head=='6aea64baac1678cbce8ba4b1a41ab04756225c7d'

 json.dump(result,stream,sort_keys=True,indent=2,allow_nan=False); stream.write('\n'); stream.flush(); os.fsync(stream.fileno())
print(json.dumps({'status':'PASS','binding_count':len(bindings),'out':str(path.relative_to(root)),'sha256':sha(path),'production_outputs_absent':True,'source_head':head},sort_keys=True))
